CurveContainer

Type: object

Hash table of Curve objects

No Additional Properties

Curve Pattern Property

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^.+$
root Curve
Type: object

A multi-purpose curve or functional relationship between an independent variable (X-axis) and dependent (Y-axis) variables.

Curve

root Curve anyOf Curve
Type: object

A multi-purpose curve or functional relationship between an independent variable (X-axis) and dependent (Y-axis) variables.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas
Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData
Type: object

Multi-purpose data points for defining a curve. The use of this generic class is discouraged if a more specific class can be used to specify the X and Y axis values along with their specific data types.

No Additional Properties

CurveData.xvalue

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.xvalue
Type: number

The data value of the X-axis variable, depending on the X-axis units.

CurveData.y1value

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y1value
Type: number

The data value of the first Y-axis variable, depending on the Y-axis units.

CurveData.y2value

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y2value
Type: number

The data value of the second Y-axis variable (if present), depending on the Y-axis units.

CurveData.y3value

root Curve anyOf Curve Curve.CurveDatas CurveData CurveData.y3value
Type: number

The data value of the third Y-axis variable (if present), depending on the Y-axis units.

root Curve anyOf Curve EmissionCurve.emissionType
Type: enum (of string)

The type of emission, which also gives the production rate measurement unit. The y1AxisUnits of the curve contains the unit of measure (e.g. kg) and the emissionType is the type of emission (e.g. sulfur dioxide).

Must be one of:

  • "EmissionType.carbonDisulfide"
  • "EmissionType.chlorine"
  • "EmissionType.sulfurDioxide"
  • "EmissionType.carbonDioxide"
  • "EmissionType.hydrogenSulfide"
  • "EmissionType.nitrogenOxide"

RampRateCurve.constraintRampType

root Curve anyOf Curve RampRateCurve.constraintRampType
Type: enum (of string)

The condition that identifies whether a Generating Resource should be constrained from Ancillary Service provision if its Schedule or Dispatch change across Trading Hours or Trading Intervals requires more than a specified fraction of the duration of the Trading Hour or Trading Interval.

Valid values are Fast/Slow

Must be one of:

  • "ConstraintRampType.SLOW"
  • "ConstraintRampType.FAST"

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf Curve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

ReserveDemandCurve.reserveRequirementType

root Curve anyOf Curve ReserveDemandCurve.reserveRequirementType

Reserve requirement type that the max and curve apply to. For example, operating reserve, regulation and contingency.

Must be one of:

  • "ReserveRequirementType.CONT"
  • "ReserveRequirementType.REG"
  • "ReserveRequirementType.OPRSV"

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf Curve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf DispatchCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf DispatchCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf DispatchCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf DispatchCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

StartUpTimeCurve

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve
Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

StartRampCurve

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve
Type: object

Rate in gross active power per minute (Y-axis) at which a unit can be loaded versus the number of hours (X-axis) the unit was off line.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve Curve.CurveDatas
Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

StartRampCurve.hotStandbyRamp

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve StartRampCurve.hotStandbyRamp
Type: object or number

The startup ramp rate in gross for a unit that is on hot standby.

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf StartRampCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

ShutdownCurve

root Curve anyOf ShutdownCurve
Type: object

Relationship between the rate in gross active power/minute (Y-axis) at which a unit should be shutdown and its present gross MW output (X-axis).

No Additional Properties

Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf ShutdownCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

ReactiveCapabilityCurve

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve
Type: object

Reactive power rating envelope versus the synchronous machine's active power, in both the generating and motoring modes. For each active power value there is a corresponding high and low reactive power limit value. Typically there will be a separate curve for each coolant condition, such as hydrogen pressure. The Y1 axis values represent reactive minimum and the Y2 axis values represent reactive maximum.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve Curve.CurveDatas
Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

Must be one of:

  • "CurveStyle.straightLineYValues"

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf ReactiveCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

HeatRateCurve

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve
Type: object

Relationship between unit heat rate per active power (Y-axis) and unit output (X-axis). The heat input is from all fuels.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve Curve.CurveDatas
Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

HeatRateCurve.isNetGrossP

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve HeatRateCurve.isNetGrossP
Type: boolean

Flag is set to true when output is expressed in net active power.

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf HeatRateCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

EmissionCurve

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve
Type: object

Relationship between the unit's emission rate in units of mass per hour (Y-axis) and output active power (X-axis) for a given type of emission. This curve applies when only one type of fuel is being burned.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve Curve.CurveDatas
Type: array

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

Curve.curveStyle

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve Curve.curveStyle
Type: enum (of string)

The style or shape of the curve.

Must be one of:

  • "CurveStyle.straightLineYValues"
  • "CurveStyle.constantYValue"

EmissionCurve.isNetGrossP

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve EmissionCurve.isNetGrossP
Type: boolean

Flag is set to true when output is expressed in net active power.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

EmissionCurve.emissionType

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve EmissionCurve.emissionType
Type: enum (of string)

The type of emission, which also gives the production rate measurement unit. The y1AxisUnits of the curve contains the unit of measure (e.g. kg) and the emissionType is the type of emission (e.g. sulfur dioxide).

Must be one of:

  • "EmissionType.carbonDisulfide"
  • "EmissionType.chlorine"
  • "EmissionType.sulfurDioxide"
  • "EmissionType.carbonDioxide"
  • "EmissionType.hydrogenSulfide"
  • "EmissionType.nitrogenOxide"

root Curve anyOf EmissionCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf VsCapabilityCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

StartUpCostCurve

root Curve anyOf StartUpCostCurve
Type: object

Startup costs and time as a function of down time. Relationship between unit startup cost (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf StartUpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf StartUpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf StartUpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf StartUpCostCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

FuelCostCurve

root Curve anyOf FuelCostCurve
Type: object

Relationship between unit fuel cost in $/kWh(Y-axis) and unit output in MW (X-axis).

No Additional Properties

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf FuelCostCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf FuelCostCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf FuelCostCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf FuelCostCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

RampRateCurve

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve
Type: object

Ramp rate as a function of resource MW output.

No Additional Properties

Curve.CurveDatas

Array of CurveData objects

Same definition as Curve.CurveDatas

How ramp rate is applied (e.g. raise or lower, as when applied to a generation resource)

  • "RampRateType.LD_PICKUP"

  • "RampRateType.OP"

  • "RampRateType.INTERTIE"

RampRateCurve.constraintRampType

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve RampRateCurve.constraintRampType
Type: enum (of string)

The condition that identifies whether a Generating Resource should be constrained from Ancillary Service provision if its Schedule or Dispatch change across Trading Hours or Trading Intervals requires more than a specified fraction of the duration of the Trading Hour or Trading Interval.

Valid values are Fast/Slow

Must be one of:

  • "ConstraintRampType.SLOW"
  • "ConstraintRampType.FAST"

IdentifiedObject.description

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root Curve anyOf RampRateCurve IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

StartUpTimeCurve

root Curve anyOf StartUpTimeCurve
Type: object

Startup time curve as a function of down time, where time is specified in minutes. Relationship between unit startup time (Y1-axis) vs. unit elapsed down time (X-axis).

Same definition as StartUpTimeCurve
